_about: Public-domain David Dickson (c.1583-1663, Scottish covenanting minister, professor of divinity at Glasgow and Edinburgh) for the Word Hoard: Select Practical Writings, vol. 1 (Edinburgh: Free Church of Scotland, 1845) and The Sum of Saving Knowledge (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1886, written with James Durham), raw Internet Archive OCR from Princeton scans. His Psalms, Hebrews and Matthew commentaries survive on IA only as 17th-century printings or an upload without library provenance. CCEL and Gutenberg hold none of it. Added 2026-10-02 by lane A, round 7 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

ddickson-select-writings-1: Select Practical Writings of David Dickson, vol. 1 (Edinburgh, 1845)
ddickson-sum-of-saving-knowledge-1886: The Sum of Saving Knowledge, with Durham; introduction and notes by John Macpherson (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1886)
